name: Bonecaller
body:
You are able to summon skeletal creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Ossuarite druid archetype.

Benefit: When you cast the spells summon nature’s ally I-IX from druid spell slots, you summon a skeletal version(s) of the creatures on that spell list (adding the graveborne simple template to that creature).
